Panthers vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, October 29 · NFL Week 8 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 29, 6:41 PM ET

Jordan Love has the highest SPAGS projection in the Panthers at Packers DraftKings Showdown: 17.8 points at $10,000 FLEX, 26.7 at captain for $15,000. Across 100,000 simulations Love holds 60% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Love is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.9 points at a $10,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 46.5-point total.

Chuba Hubbard has the largest captain share: 14.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Hubbard at captain. The model gives him 17.4 carries and 2.9 targets. Tetairoa McMillan is the next captain in line, at 12.1%. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 34.4 routes.

Green Bay is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 25 for the Packers and 21.5 for the Panthers.

Behind Love, Hubbard and McMillan, the next projections are Bryce Young (16.8, $9,600), Josh Jacobs (15.6, $8,800) and Christian Watson (15.1, $9,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 29, 6:41 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Chuba Hubbard holds 14.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 17.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 17.4 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Hubbard averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 35.2. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.0% as the captain and 42.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Tetairoa McMillan holds 12.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 15.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 34.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations McMillan averaged 15.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 41.2. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.1% as the captain and 29.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Josh Jacobs, GB RB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Josh Jacobs holds 11.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 15.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 13.4 carries and 3.7 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Jacobs averaged 15.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.7 and a ceiling of 33.7. He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.8% as the captain and 36.4% in a FLEX spot.

Jordan Love leads the SPAGS model at 17.8 DraftKings points for $10,000 at FLEX, or 26.7 points at captain for $15,000.

Jordan Love is the most expensive player at $10,000 FLEX and $15,000 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.
